projects.name: Strengthening of policy, institutional, and technical foundations for sustainable land, water, and natural resource management.
projects.description: Assistance will focus on improving irrigation efficiency, combating land degradation, and promoting soil and water conservation through practical, scalable solutions that can be adopted across diverse agro-ecological regions. These efforts contribute to a more competitive, diversified, and sustainable non-oil economy and to expanded opportunities for productive employment in rural areas.

projects.name: Integrated Spatial Planning for Sustainable Urban Development – Towards smart, resilient and inclusive human settlements in the East Zangezur Economic Region
projects.description: The project aims to support the State Committee on Urban Planning and Architecture (SCUPA) of the Republic of Azerbaijan and key stakeholders in implementing the strategies and principles of its Regional Plan by contributing to improved strategic spatial planning approaches for the reconstruction of two conflict-affected villages located in the East Zangezur Economic Region. Through an integrated and participatory approach to the preparation of the urban plans, the project will help translate and localize global and contemporary planning principles, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) - in particular SDG11 – the New Urban Agenda, the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and best practices applicable to comparable local conditions and contexts. Hereby, the outcomes from the project will demonstrate possibilities to promote climate adaptation and mitigation, enhanced resilience to shocks, diversification and revitalized economic development, people-centered smart cities, preservation of culture and identity, as well as embedding cross-cutting issues such as gender, youth and marginalized groups – including ageing citizens and people with disabilities – in the planning process.

projects.name: Promoting Kahriz Rehabilitation for Enhanced Water-Related Climate Adaptation in Azerbaijan
projects.description: Funded by IOM Sasakawa Endowment Fund. The Kahriz is a traditional decentralized water supply system in Azerbaijan, which is fed through subterranean water. It has played a vital role in accessing groundwater extraction since ancient times in the arid zones of Azerbaijan.  In light of the above, the objective of this project is to contribute to enhanced water-related adaptation in the context of long-term impacts of climate variability and change in the Republic of Azerbaijan.
